patterns.name: atomic_subsumption
patterns.origin: OWL2 SubClassOf to a named/BFO-CCO upper class (repo subclass_basic / subclass_to_* ; 509/540 templates are SubClassOf-headed; BFO 2020 is-a backbone)
patterns.owl2_construct: SubClassOf(C, NamedClass-or-anchorIRI)
patterns.bfo_cco_anchor: bfo:Continuant / bfo:IndependentContinuant(bfo:0000004) / bfo:Process(bfo:0000015) / cco:Artifact / cco:ont00000958 — when {A} is a literal anchor IRI it IS the bfo_anchor_path[-1]; pure rdfs:subClassOf+
patterns.cleanroom_note: OWL2 core + BFO/CCO public IRIs; FHIR Resource-typing minimum. clean.
patterns.verbalization_hint: Every {X} is a kind of {A}.

patterns.name: backbone_element_nesting
patterns.origin: FHIR BackboneElement nested child (e.g. Observation.component 0..*) — an anonymous typed sub-structure specific-dependent on its parent; audit-missing 'nested-backbone'
patterns.owl2_construct: SubClassOf(C, ObjectSomeValuesFrom(p, ChildClass)) + child SubClassOf(ObjectSomeValuesFrom(partOf, C)) specific-dependence
patterns.bfo_cco_anchor: bfo:0000051 (has continuant part) / bfo:0000050 (part of): {Y} is a generically-dependent sub-ICE that bfo:0000050 some {X}; the backbone child specifically depends on its parent record.
patterns.cleanroom_note: FHIR CC0; BackboneElement nesting is a public-domain compositional idiom. clean.
patterns.verbalization_hint: Each {X} contains nested {Y} components via {p}.

patterns.name: cardinality_optional_repeating
patterns.origin: FHIR element cardinality 0..* (optional, repeating); repo universal_restriction (range-typed open collection)
patterns.owl2_construct: SubClassOf(C, ObjectAllValuesFrom(p, Y)) — open multi-valued, range-guarded, no lower bound
patterns.bfo_cco_anchor: a non-functional BFO/CCO relation with a range guard; {X} may bear zero-or-more {Y}, all typed {Y}.
patterns.cleanroom_note: FHIR CC0; cardinality notation is generic. clean. ('only' does NOT force NOT NULL per realize.py — non-mandatory association.)
patterns.verbalization_hint: A {X} may have any number of {Y} (all via {p}).

patterns.name: cardinality_optional_single
patterns.origin: FHIR element cardinality 0..1 (optional, non-repeating); repo qualified_cardinality_restriction (max)
patterns.owl2_construct: SubClassOf(C, ObjectMaxCardinality(1, p, Y))
patterns.bfo_cco_anchor: a functional-ish BFO/CCO relation; {X} bears at most one {Y}, no existence commitment.
patterns.cleanroom_note: FHIR CC0; cardinality notation is generic. clean. (max captured-not-enforced in DDL — Trino has no CHECK.)
patterns.verbalization_hint: A {X} has at most one {Y}.

patterns.name: cardinality_required_repeating
patterns.origin: FHIR element cardinality 1..* (required, repeating — at least one); repo cardinality_min_one
patterns.owl2_construct: SubClassOf(C, ObjectMinCardinality(1, p, Y))
patterns.bfo_cco_anchor: a non-functional BFO/CCO relation with an existence floor; {X} bears at least one {Y} (mandatory multi-valued).
patterns.cleanroom_note: FHIR CC0; cardinality notation is generic. clean. (min 1 → target NOT NULL per realize.py.)
patterns.verbalization_hint: A {X} has at least one {Y} via {p}.

patterns.name: cardinality_required_single
patterns.origin: FHIR element cardinality 1..1 (required, non-repeating); repo qualified_cardinality_restriction (exactly)
patterns.owl2_construct: SubClassOf(C, ObjectExactCardinality(1, p, Y))
patterns.bfo_cco_anchor: a functional BFO/CCO relation; {X} stands in the relation to exactly one {Y} (mandatory single bearer).
patterns.cleanroom_note: FHIR CC0; cardinality notation is generic. clean.
patterns.verbalization_hint: A {X} has exactly one {Y}.

patterns.name: coded_concept_extensible_binding
patterns.origin: FHIR CodeableConcept bound with EXTENSIBLE strength (use a value-set code if one applies, else out-of-set permitted)
patterns.owl2_construct: SubClassOf(C, ObjectSomeValuesFrom(p, Y)) WITHOUT a closing universal (open-world: supplemental fillers allowed)
patterns.bfo_cco_anchor: cco:ont00000853 bearing a cco:designates relation onto concept class {Y}; absence of a covering axiom keeps the open-world supplement admissible. Leading literal clause anchors.
patterns.cleanroom_note: FHIR CC0; extensible-vs-required is a reusable modelling distinction. clean.
patterns.verbalization_hint: Every {X} is coded with at least one concept, preferably from {Y}.

patterns.name: coded_concept_required_binding
patterns.origin: FHIR CodeableConcept/Coding bound to a ValueSet with REQUIRED strength (code SHALL be drawn from the expansion); audit-missing 'value-partition'
patterns.owl2_construct: SubClassOf(C, ObjectSomeValuesFrom(p, OneOf{i1..in})) ∧ SubClassOf(C, ObjectAllValuesFrom(p, OneOf{i1..in})) — enumerated, closed
patterns.bfo_cco_anchor: cco:ont00000686 — {X} bears a code that cco:designates a concept; {Y} is the BFO-anchored concept/value-partition class enumerating the closed CodeSystem members. NO proprietary codes — {Y} is an ontology-derived enum class.
patterns.cleanroom_note: FHIR CC0; binding-strength is a reusable concept; NO SNOMED/LOINC content — enum members are sdg:-derived. clean.
patterns.verbalization_hint: Every {X} is coded with exactly one concept drawn from the closed set {Y}.

patterns.name: composite_interval_period
patterns.origin: FHIR Period (start/end:dateTime) / Range (low/high) — a bounded interval; audit-missing 'composite-datatype'
patterns.owl2_construct: EquivalentClasses(C, ObjectIntersectionOf(anchor, DataSomeValuesFrom(d, xsd:dateTime), DataSomeValuesFrom(e, xsd:dateTime)))
patterns.manchester_skeleton: Class: {X:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000853 and ({d:DataProperty} some xsd:dateTime) and ({e:DataProperty} some xsd:dateTime)
patterns.bfo_cco_anchor: bfo:0000008 (temporal region) flavor for Period; two paired bound data properties on one node (start/end or low/high). cco:ont00000853 anchor keeps it catalog-realizable.
patterns.cleanroom_note: FHIR CC0; interval-with-two-bounds is a public-domain idiom. clean.
patterns.verbalization_hint: A {X} spans from a start (via {d}) to an end (via {e}).

patterns.name: composite_quantity_datatype
patterns.origin: FHIR Quantity datatype (value:decimal + unit:code + system:uri) — a measure-bearing structured node; audit-missing 'composite-datatype'
patterns.owl2_construct: EquivalentClasses(C, ObjectIntersectionOf(anchor, DataSomeValuesFrom(d, xsd:decimal), ObjectSomeValuesFrom(p, UnitClass)))
patterns.manchester_skeleton: Class: {X:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000853 and ({d:DataProperty} some xsd:decimal) and ({p:ObjectProperty} some {Y:Class})
patterns.bfo_cco_anchor: cco:ont00000853 / bfo:0000019 (quality) — {X} is a measurement ICE carrying a magnitude (data property) and cco:uses_measurement_unit onto a unit class {Y} (cco:MeasurementUnit). Parenthesized conjuncts so _RESTRICTION_RE/_DP_RANGE_RE find them.
patterns.cleanroom_note: FHIR CC0; Quantity field layout is public-domain structure. clean.
patterns.verbalization_hint: A {X} has a numeric value (via {d}) and a unit (via {p} onto {Y}).

patterns.name: contained_local_dependent
patterns.origin: FHIR contained resources (Resource.contained, fragment '#id') — inline resource with no independent identity, resolvable only within its container
patterns.owl2_construct: SubClassOf(C, ObjectSomeValuesFrom(bfo:0000051, Y)) + specific-dependence on the container
patterns.bfo_cco_anchor: bfo:0000051 (has continuant part) where {Y} is a generically-dependent continuant whose identity is scoped to its container {X}; cannot exist outside it. Body uses opaque numeric IRI (→ _OPAQUE_PROP_LABELS has_part).
patterns.cleanroom_note: FHIR CC0; contained-resource scoping is a reusable structural concept. clean.
patterns.verbalization_hint: A {X} contains an inline {Y} that exists only within it.

patterns.name: modifier_extension_negation
patterns.origin: FHIR modifierExtension — an extension that CHANGES interpretation (must be understood); RDF prefixes the modified property with underscore
patterns.owl2_construct: EquivalentClasses(C, ObjectIntersectionOf(Y, ObjectComplementOf(ObjectSomeValuesFrom(p, Z)))) — meaning-altering qualification
patterns.bfo_cco_anchor: cco:ont00000965 — the modifier asserts {X} is NOT the default reading; a meaning-bearing ICE that defeats an otherwise-entailed class membership.
patterns.cleanroom_note: FHIR CC0; modifierExtension must-understand semantics are reusable. clean.
patterns.verbalization_hint: A {X} is a {Y} that does NOT {p} a {Z} (the modifier negates the default).

patterns.name: open_world_extension
patterns.origin: FHIR Extension (url:uri + value[x], nested sub-extensions) — open-world addition of data not in the base resource, keyed by a StructureDefinition URL
patterns.owl2_construct: Open SubClassOf(C, ObjectSomeValuesFrom(p, ExtensionClass)) deliberately WITHOUT closure (OWA preserved)
patterns.bfo_cco_anchor: cco:ont00000958 — {Y} is a supplemental ICE bfo:0000050 (part of) the record {X}, identified by a cco designator (the extension url); no closure axiom preserves the open-world assumption.
patterns.cleanroom_note: FHIR CC0; extension/open-world mechanism is a reusable design concept. clean.
patterns.verbalization_hint: A {X} may carry additional {Y} extensions via {p}, identified by a URL.

patterns.name: polymorphic_value_choice
patterns.origin: FHIR value[x] choice element — one predicate whose object self-types (Quantity | string | CodeableConcept …); audit-missing 'choice-type union'
patterns.owl2_construct: SubClassOf(C, ObjectSomeValuesFrom(p, ObjectUnionOf(Y, Z))) ∧ SubClassOf(C, ObjectAllValuesFrom(p, ObjectUnionOf(Y, Z)))
patterns.bfo_cco_anchor: cco:ont00000853 bearer; cco carrier relation onto a value entity whose kind is one of a closed BFO-typed union — the disjunctive filler closed by the universal restriction
patterns.cleanroom_note: FHIR CC0 value[x] choice; the polymorphic value is one value-class {Y} closed by `only`, its typed variants modeled by a disjoint_union on {Y}. Parseable by realize._RESTRICTION_RE.
patterns.verbalization_hint: The value of {X} is either a {Y} or a {Z}.

patterns.name: typed_cross_resource_reference
patterns.origin: FHIR Reference datatype / fhir:link (typed, target-constrained cross-resource link, e.g. Reference(Patient)); repo existential_restriction_iri_prop / labrun_uses
patterns.owl2_construct: SubClassOf(C, ObjectSomeValuesFrom(p, Y)) — qualified existential whose range names the target type
patterns.bfo_cco_anchor: cco:ont00000958/bfo:Process record that cco:is_about / bfo:0000050 (part of) its referent; the link property points {X} (an ICE record) at {Y} (the referent entity). Leading literal clause is bfo_anchor_path[-1].
patterns.cleanroom_note: FHIR CC0; structural reference idiom only, no resource content copied. clean. [convention: numeric bfo:0000015 in the axiom BODY is correct per the real catalog (e.g. labrun_with_protocol); prefixed labels go in bfo_anchor_path].
patterns.verbalization_hint: Every {X} refers to some {Y} via {p}.

patterns.name: typed_primitive_dataproperty
patterns.origin: FHIR typed primitive via fhir:v with an XSD type; repo dataproperty_typed_restriction (audit-missing 'dataproperty-slot'; realize.py supports it but the catalog exercises ZERO)
patterns.owl2_construct: SubClassOf(C, DataSomeValuesFrom(d, xsd:type)) — datatype-restricted literal node
patterns.bfo_cco_anchor: cco:ont00000958 bearing a cco data value via a data property; the literal node is the cco:has_*_value carrier with an xsd-typed range (BFO-anchored quality magnitude). _DP_RANGE_RE maps slot→range.
patterns.cleanroom_note: FHIR CC0 + xsd (W3C). clean. This is the ONLY axiom-body path to typed/measure columns — the catalog currently has none.
patterns.verbalization_hint: A {X} carries a typed primitive value via {d} of type xsd:dateTime.

patterns.name: anchored_subclass
patterns.origin: OWL2 SubClassOf with a LITERAL BFO/CCO anchor as superclass (repo anchored_subclass / subclass_to_artifact) — drives anchor_attributes() typed-column pool
patterns.owl2_construct: SubClassOf(C, anchorIRI)
patterns.bfo_cco_anchor: The literal super IS the anchor; bfo_anchor_path MUST list it. ddl._anchor_root reads bfo_anchor_path[-1]; anchor_attributes inherits its + ancestors' DataProperties via _ANCHOR_PARENTS. Allowed: cco:Artifact, bfo:Process, cco:{Descriptive,Directive,Designative}ICE, cco:ont00000958, bfo:IndependentContinuant.
patterns.cleanroom_note: OWL2 core; BFO/CCO public. clean.
patterns.verbalization_hint: Every {X} is a kind of artifact.

patterns.name: complement_negation
patterns.origin: OWL2 ObjectComplementOf (negation); repo equiv_intersect_with_negation; audit-missing 'not (negation)'
patterns.owl2_construct: EquivalentClasses(C, ObjectIntersectionOf(G, ObjectComplementOf(D)))
patterns.bfo_cco_anchor: Carves a residual within a BFO genus {G} by excluding {D} (e.g. a non-artifact information content entity: cco:ont00000958 and not cco:Artifact).
patterns.cleanroom_note: OWL2 standard, already in catalog. clean.
patterns.verbalization_hint: An {X} is a {G} that is not a {D}.

patterns.name: datatype_facet_restriction
patterns.origin: OWL2 DatatypeRestriction with xsd constraining facets (minInclusive/maxInclusive/length/pattern); audit-missing 'datatype-facet' + 'dataproperty-slot'
patterns.owl2_construct: SubClassOf(C, DataSomeValuesFrom(d, DatatypeRestriction(xsd:type, facet)))
patterns.bfo_cco_anchor: Constrains the measurement value of a quality/ICE (e.g. an sdg measurement whose sdg:hasConfidence/hasLatitude is bounded in [0,1]). _DP_RANGE_RE matches the slot→xsd range; the facet rides as a CheckNote.
patterns.cleanroom_note: OWL2 + W3C XSD facets, standard. clean.
patterns.verbalization_hint: An {X}'s {d} is an xsd:decimal between 0 and 1.

patterns.name: disjoint_classes
patterns.origin: OWL2 DisjointClasses; audit-missing 'disjoint'
patterns.owl2_construct: DisjointClasses(C, D) (C SubClassOf ObjectComplementOf(D))
patterns.bfo_cco_anchor: Sibling continuants under a common BFO genus that must not overlap (e.g. cco:Artifact vs a non-artifact ICE sibling); mirrors BFO's continuant/occurrent disjointness.
patterns.cleanroom_note: OWL2 standard. clean.
patterns.verbalization_hint: Nothing is both an {X} and a {Y}.

patterns.name: disjoint_union_partition
patterns.origin: OWL2 DisjointUnion (covering + pairwise-disjoint partition); OWL2 'Value Partition' best-practice closed quality space
patterns.owl2_construct: DisjointUnion(C, D1 … Dn)
patterns.bfo_cco_anchor: Exhaustive subdivision of a BFO/CCO genus (e.g. cco:ont00000958 DisjointUnionOf Designative/Descriptive/Prescriptive ICE — the project's own ICE triad); or a determinable bfo:0000019 quality whose determinates are a fixed value-set (sdg severity/classification tiers).
patterns.cleanroom_note: OWL2 standard + W3C value-partition note; ICE triad is CCO-public, reused by IRI. clean.
patterns.verbalization_hint: Every {X} is exactly one of: a {Y}, a {Z}, or a {W}, and these never overlap.

patterns.name: enumerated_class_oneof
patterns.origin: OWL2 ObjectOneOf (nominals / enumerated class)
patterns.owl2_construct: EquivalentClasses(C, ObjectOneOf(i1 … in))
patterns.bfo_cco_anchor: A class whose extension is a fixed roster of named individuals (e.g. recognized compliance frameworks sdg:underFramework targets), anchored under cco:ont00000958.
patterns.cleanroom_note: OWL2 standard. clean. (Individuals are sdg:-derived nominals, not proprietary codes.)
patterns.verbalization_hint: An {X} is exactly one of {i1}, {i2}, or {i3}.

patterns.name: equivalent_class_definition
patterns.origin: OWL2 EquivalentClasses + ObjectIntersectionOf (genus-differentia / Defined Class); repo equivalent_intersection (31 EquivalentTo templates)
patterns.owl2_construct: EquivalentClasses(C, ObjectIntersectionOf(G, ObjectSomeValuesFrom(p, D)))
patterns.bfo_cco_anchor: Genus {G} is a BFO Continuant subtree (or cco:Artifact); differentia {p} some {D} narrows it. The parenthesized restriction conjunct IS matched by _RESTRICTION_RE so it grounds a junction; the bare named-class genus becomes an entity column.
patterns.cleanroom_note: OWL2 standard; genus-differentia is Aristotelian, no third-party text. clean.
patterns.verbalization_hint: An {X} is exactly a {G} that {p} some {D}.

patterns.name: has_value_pinned_filler
patterns.origin: OWL2 ObjectHasValue / DataHasValue (restriction to a specific filler/individual)
patterns.owl2_construct: SubClassOf(C, ObjectHasValue(p, i))
patterns.bfo_cco_anchor: Pins a relation of a class to one fixed individual (e.g. every {X} sdg:underStandard a specific standard-individual, or bound to a fixed cco organization individual).
patterns.cleanroom_note: OWL2 standard. clean.
patterns.verbalization_hint: Every {X} {p} the specific individual {i}.

patterns.name: multi_restriction_conjunction
patterns.origin: OWL2 conjunction of restrictions (comma-separated SubClassOf clauses); repo multi_restriction_conjunction (existential_two_clauses; 18 templates with ≥2 restrictions) — the ONLY shape reaching multi-FK / dense-M:N
patterns.owl2_construct: SubClassOf(C, R1) ∧ SubClassOf(C, R2), each an existential/cardinality restriction
patterns.bfo_cco_anchor: Optional leading literal anchor clause, then ≥2 restriction clauses; properties may be slots or literal IRIs interchangeably. parse_restrictions returns a LIST → _realize_junction emits one junction table per restriction (multi-FK), _realize_star one dimension per restriction.
patterns.cleanroom_note: OWL2 core. clean. THIS is the shape new junction/star patterns must emit to ground >1 FK.
patterns.verbalization_hint: {X} relates to {Y} via {p} and to {Z} via {q}.

patterns.name: object_property_characteristics
patterns.origin: OWL2 property axioms (Transitive/Functional/InverseFunctional/Symmetric/InverseOf)
patterns.owl2_construct: TransitiveObjectProperty(p); FunctionalObjectProperty(p); InverseObjectProperties(p, q)
patterns.bfo_cco_anchor: Stamps the global behaviour of a BFO/sdg relation: bfo:0000050 partOf is Transitive, bfo:0000051 hasPart its InverseOf; an identifier relation (sdg:hasIdentifier) is Functional/InverseFunctional (a key). (SubPropertyOf carries the axiom keyword; characteristics ride as annotations the step-3 generator attaches.)
patterns.cleanroom_note: OWL2 standard. clean. (Functional→single-valued UNIQUE FK; InverseFunctional→candidate-key; Symmetric→undirected edge table; Transitive→closure table.)
patterns.verbalization_hint: {p} is a sub-property of (and inverse/transitive over) {q}.

patterns.name: property_chain_inclusion
patterns.origin: OWL2 SubObjectPropertyOf with ObjectPropertyChain (role composition); audit-missing 'property-chain (o)'
patterns.owl2_construct: SubObjectPropertyOf(ObjectPropertyChain(p, q), r)
patterns.bfo_cco_anchor: Composes BFO/sdg relations (e.g. (sdg:hasColumn o sdg:hasValueType) ⊑ a derived sdg:hasColumnValueType; or (bfo:0000050 o bfo:0000050) → partOf transitivity as a chain).
patterns.cleanroom_note: OWL2 standard. clean. (Grounds a derived bridge relation: a JOIN view, or a closure table for self-chains.)
patterns.verbalization_hint: If something {p} a Y and that Y {q} a Z, then it {r} the Z.

patterns.name: universal_value_restriction
patterns.origin: OWL2 ObjectAllValuesFrom (universal / local range-typing); repo universal_restriction (26 'only' templates); audit-missing 'only (universal)'
patterns.owl2_construct: SubClassOf(C, ObjectAllValuesFrom(p, D))
patterns.bfo_cco_anchor: Local range narrowing of a BFO/CCO relation for one subject class (e.g. cco:ont00000965 that {p} only {governed-class}).
patterns.cleanroom_note: OWL2 standard. clean.
patterns.verbalization_hint: All of an {X}'s {p} fillers are {D}.

patterns.name: agent_role
patterns.origin: ODP 'AgentRole' — a role performedBy exactly 1 Agent, isAgentRoleIn some context; repo sdg:hasAgentRole/hasRole/responsibleFor
patterns.owl2_construct: SubClassOf(AgentRole, ObjectExactCardinality(1, isPerformedBy, Agent) ∧ ObjectSomeValuesFrom(isAgentRoleIn, Context))
patterns.bfo_cco_anchor: {R} a bfo:0000023 (role); {A} the bearer (cco:Person / agent, inheres via the role-bearer link); {ri} ties the role to its realizing context {C}.
patterns.cleanroom_note: ODP shape; role grounded on bfo:0000023, not DUL Role; performedBy/isAgentRoleIn semantics reimplemented. clean-room. (Role-as-association-class with temporal holding.)
patterns.verbalization_hint: An {R} is a role performed by exactly one {A} within some {C}.

patterns.name: collection_membership
patterns.origin: ODP 'Collection' (hasMember/isMemberOf between a Collection and members — distinct from mereological partOf)
patterns.owl2_construct: SubClassOf(Collection, ObjectSomeValuesFrom(hasMember, Entity)); InverseObjectProperties(hasMember, isMemberOf)
patterns.bfo_cco_anchor: {X} a collection/aggregate (cco ICE that gathers members without mereological parthood); {m} ~ sdg:aggregates; {Y} member continuants. No transitivity, no constitution — kept distinct from bfo:partOf.
patterns.cleanroom_note: ODP shape; membership kept distinct from bfo:partOf, our IRIs. clean-room.
patterns.verbalization_hint: An {X} is a collection that has some {Y} as a member.

patterns.name: componency_direct_part
patterns.origin: ODP 'Componency' (hasComponent/isComponentOf — NON-transitive direct proper-parthood, subPropertyOf hasPart)
patterns.owl2_construct: SubObjectPropertyOf(hasComponent, hasPart); SubClassOf(C, ObjectSomeValuesFrom(c, D)) [c non-transitive]
patterns.bfo_cco_anchor: {c} is a direct-component relation, SubPropertyOf bfo:0000051 hasPart but deliberately non-transitive (immediate assembly level); {X},{D} bfo:0000004 independent continuants / cco:Artifact.
patterns.cleanroom_note: ODP shape (non-transitivity is load-bearing); reimplemented over bfo:hasPart. clean-room.
patterns.verbalization_hint: An {X} has {D} as a direct component.

patterns.name: description_and_situation
patterns.origin: ODP 'Description and Situation' (DnS) — a Situation satisfies a Description and isSettingFor entities; repo sdg:satisfies/specifies/describedBy
patterns.owl2_construct: SubClassOf(Situation, ObjectSomeValuesFrom(satisfies, Description) ∧ ObjectSomeValuesFrom(isSettingFor, Entity))
patterns.bfo_cco_anchor: {D} a descriptive/directive ICE (cco:ont00000853/Prescriptive ICE) prescribing a frame; {S} a situation ICE that {sat}=sdg:satisfies the description and {sf} is-setting-for involved entities {E}. The policy-vs-observed-state compliance shape.
patterns.cleanroom_note: DnS is the abstract DUL core; reimplemented as situation-satisfies-description over cco ICE subtypes + sdg:satisfies, no DUL axioms copied. clean-room.
patterns.verbalization_hint: A situation {S} satisfies a description {D} and is the setting for some {E}.

patterns.name: information_realization
patterns.origin: ODP 'InformationRealization' — a concrete carrier realizes an abstract InformationObject which isAbout an Entity; repo sdg:isAbout
patterns.owl2_construct: SubClassOf(Carrier, ObjectSomeValuesFrom(realizes, InformationObject)); InformationObject SubClassOf ObjectSomeValuesFrom(isAbout, Entity)
patterns.bfo_cco_anchor: {I} a cco:ont00000958 (abstract information object); {C} its concrete carrier (bfo:0000004 independent continuant) that {rz}=concretizes/realizes it (cf. bfo:0000059 concretizes); {ab}=sdg:isAbout the subject {E}.
patterns.cleanroom_note: ODP shape; grounded on BFO concretization (bfo:0000058/59) + cco ICE + sdg:isAbout. clean-room.
patterns.verbalization_hint: A concrete {C} realizes the information object {I}, which is about {E}.

patterns.name: participation_occurrent_continuant
patterns.origin: ODP 'Participation' (occurrent has_participant continuant) + RO has_participant; FHIR Encounter.participant; repo observation_with_participant
patterns.owl2_construct: SubClassOf(Process, ObjectSomeValuesFrom(bfo:0000057, Continuant))
patterns.bfo_cco_anchor: {X} a bfo:0000015 (process); bfo:0000057 has_participant (inverse bfo:0000056 participates_in); {Y} a bfo:Continuant. Direct BFO realization of the ODP Participation pattern. Body opaque IRI → has_participant column.
patterns.cleanroom_note: ODP shape (CC-BY); reuses STRUCTURE with bfo:0000015/0000057 instead of DUL Event/hasParticipant. clean-room.
patterns.verbalization_hint: An {X} is a process in which some {Y} participates.

patterns.name: partonomy_bfo_relation
patterns.origin: ODP 'PartOf' (transitive mereology) + BFO/RO bfo:0000050 partOf / 0000051 hasPart; repo partonomy_bfo_relation / existential_with_part_of
patterns.owl2_construct: SubClassOf(C, ObjectSomeValuesFrom(bfo:0000050, D)); TransitiveObjectProperty(isPartOf)
patterns.bfo_cco_anchor: BFO-native bfo:0000050 partOf (transitive) / bfo:0000051 hasPart; {X},{Y} bfo:Continuants. Body uses the opaque numeric IRI → ddl._OPAQUE_PROP_LABELS renames the column part_of.
patterns.cleanroom_note: ODP shape but the relation is BFO-canonical (bfo:0000050), no DUL import. clean.
patterns.verbalization_hint: Every {X} is part of some {Y} (transitively).

patterns.name: reified_nary_relation
patterns.origin: W3C 'Defining N-ary Relations' note + ODP n-ary reification — a relation-individual class linking all N arguments + own attributes; audit-missing 'reified-n-ary-relation'
patterns.owl2_construct: SubClassOf(N, ObjectSomeValuesFrom(a1, A1)) ∧ (a2, A2) ∧ (a3, A3) ∧ DataSomeValuesFrom(d, xsd:type)
patterns.manchester_skeleton: Class: {N:Class} SubClassOf: cco:ont00000958, {a1:ObjectProperty} some {A1:Class}, {a2:ObjectProperty} some {A2:Class}, {d:DataProperty} some xsd:decimal
patterns.bfo_cco_anchor: {N} is a reified relation-as-ICE under cco:ont00000958 (or bfo:0000019 quality when carrying a magnitude); each {a_i} binds one role-argument {A_i}; {d} carries the relation's own attribute (sdg:hasConfidence/hasNumericValue). The abstract parent of Participation/AgentRole/DnS.
patterns.cleanroom_note: W3C public-note standard reification; our IRIs throughout. clean. (Junction = association-class with payload columns; degenerates to EAV when attrs open-ended.)
patterns.verbalization_hint: An {N} ties together an {A1} and an {A2}, and carries its own {d} value.

patterns.name: sequence_ordering

coverage_notes:
SCOPE: 56 source patterns across 5 inventories merged to 50 de-duplicated patterns spanning all four tiers (fhir_minimum 17, owl2_core 13, odp 10, sysmlv2 10). Every skeleton conforms to the repo's EXACT contract verified against src/aegir/ontology/{SLOT_DSL.md, ddl.py, realize.py}: numeric BFO IRIs in the axiom BODY (bfo:0000015/0000050/0000051/0000057/0000063/0000023/0000004) but PREFIXED labels in bfo_anchor_path (matching ddl._OPAQUE_PROP_LABELS + _ANCHOR_PARENTS); a leading literal-anchor comma-clause where the pattern needs anchor_attributes() (so bfo_anchor_path[-1] is set); EquivalentTo restrictions PARENTHESIZED so ddl._RESTRICTION_RE/_DP_RANGE_RE find the nested restriction (per the repo inventory's equivalent_intersection note); property either a literal IRI in the body or a {p:ObjectProperty} slot; multi-restriction conjunctions comma-separated so parse_restrictions returns a LIST and realize emits one junction/dimension per restriction (the only >1-FK path).

AUDIT-MISSING PATTERNS NOW COVERED (against scripts/audit_ontology_structure._TARGET_PATTERNS / envelope_missing): reified-n-ary-relation → reified_nary_relation (+ all 3 ODP reifications time_indexed_participation/agent_role/description_and_situation + SysML connection_usage_reified_link/state_transition_fsm/allocation_mapping/requirement_satisfy_verify) grounding junction; choice-type/value[x] → polymorphic_value_choice grounding eav; composite-datatype → composite_quantity_datatype + composite_interval_period (+ port_interaction_point) grounding composite-datatype; nested-backbone → backbone_element_nesting + contained_local_dependent (+ componency_direct_part/information_realization/part_definition_usage/sequence_ordering) grounding nested-child; value-partition → disjoint_union_partition + coded_concept_required_binding + variation_variant_point + enumerated_class_oneof grounding enum; disjoint → disjoint_classes + disjoint_union_partition (DisjointWith/DisjointUnionOf keywords); property-chain → property_chain_inclusion (SubPropertyChain o); datatype-facet → datatype_facet_restriction (xsd[>=,<=] bracket form ddl matches); dataproperty-slot → typed_primitive_dataproperty + attribute_usage_datavalue + datatype_facet_restriction + constraint_definition_parametric (the catalog currently exercises ZERO {d:DataProperty} restrictions though realize.py fully supports them — this is the highest-leverage gap: it is the ONLY axiom-body path to typed/measure columns, EAV per-datatype value tables, and star measures, rather than the anchor_attributes pool). Also covered: only(universal)→universal_value_restriction; not(negation)→complement_negation/modifier_extension_negation; qualified-cardinality→the four FHIR cardinality patterns + connection/transition/allocation exactly-N; and(conjunction)→equivalent_class_definition/composite_*; or(disjunction)→polymorphic_value_choice/variation_variant_point.

EXTENDS_EXISTING (generalizes the current subClassOf+some shape, 24 patterns): the FHIR cardinality quartet, reference, choice, codeable-concept, composite, backbone/contained, extension; the OWL2 anchored_subclass, equivalent_class_definition, universal/complement, multi_restriction_conjunction; all ODP partonomy/componency/participation/sequence/collection/reification patterns; and SysML part/connection/itemflow/action/state/requirement/allocation usages — all are the existing `SubClassOf … (some|min|max|exactly|only) {Y}` shape, parameterized and generalized rather than novel constructs.

SYSMLv2 CONSTRUCTS WITH THE MOST LIMS VALUE (the tier that levels UP hardest from FHIR's minimum): (1) state_transition_fsm — sample/specimen lifecycle as an explicit FSM edge table (received→accessioned→aliquoted→tested→reported→archived) is the backbone of a LIMS and grounds the richest junction (from_state/to_state/trigger/guard); (2) requirement_satisfy_verify — spec-limit → method → result traceability is the regulatory core of GxP/ISO-17025 labs, grounding a satisfy/verify traceability matrix that no FHIR pattern supplies; (3) item_flow_transfer — chain-of-custody / aliquot routing between stations as a reified transfer with conveyed-item participant; (4) action_definition_behavior + case_definition_subject_return — assay/protocol steps (reagent in → measurement out) and the test-run/QC fact table (subject + verdict); (5) constraint_definition_parametric — acceptance criteria / spec limits as parametric CHECKs over result columns; (6) allocation_mapping — method→instrument / test→workcell allocation matrices; (7) connection_usage_reified_link + port_interaction_point — instrument-interface modelling. These add the process/behavior/requirement axis (occurrents, traceability, parametric constraints) that FHIR's resource-centric minimum and even the ODP content patterns under-serve, and they ground precisely the junction/dimension/constraint DDL shapes a real LIMS warehouse needs.

NOTES ON DE-DUPLICATION: cross-inventory duplicates were merged to a single canonical pattern — FHIR Reference + OWL2/BFO existential + repo existential_restriction_iri_prop → typed_cross_resource_reference; the four QCR appearances (FHIR cardinality, OWL2 QCR, repo qualified_cardinality_restriction, SysML multiplicity) → the FHIR cardinality quartet (the finest-grained, FHIR-minimum-bar split) with SysML/OWL2 exactly-N folded into the reified link/transition/allocation patterns; OWL2 participation/part-of/sequence + the BFO-inventory duplicates + repo partonomy → the ODP set; SysML VerificationCase/AnalysisCase/UseCase (three near-identical CaseDefinition shapes) → one case_definition_subject_return; SysML Subclassification/FeatureTyping (both reduce to SubClassOf / existential already covered by atomic_subsumption + typed_cross_resource_reference) were NOT given separate entries to avoid redundancy, with Redefinition folded conceptually into subsetting_feature_subproperty. The repo's atomic_subclass + subsumption_to_upper_anchor (BFO inventory) + FHIR Resource-typing collapse to atomic_subsumption (placed at fhir_minimum since it is the literal minimum bar). The library machinery (src/aegir/ontology/patterns.py, AxiomPattern dataclass, library()/validate()/instantiate()/coverage_vs_envelope()) already exists and reads these from axiom_patterns.json — this taxonomy is the data payload for that loader; note patterns.py's validate() expects slot_meta_types as a dict and GROUNDS includes subsumption/relation in addition to the seven required here, so the loader will accept all 50.
